svg.aria-label: Achievement log. How each one was earned. Arabic-first: Right-to-left layouts designed as layouts, and a portfolio in 17+ languages.. Core Web Vitals: A performance budget set before design, and a release gate that blocks a slow page.. Grounded AI: Assistants that answer from the client's own data, a person approving what matters.. Secure by default: Every request re-checked on the server, every input treated as untrusted.. (+MVP): Sells from version one: groundwork first, no bloat, no delay for harmless flaws.
